rootFurther.intro:
Facing the whirlwind of change in the AI era and ever-rising expectations from customers, Sun* has chosen a strategy of diversifying capabilities — not only striving to be the elite in its own field, but aiming for a higher goal, where every Sunner is a “problem-solver”, an expert at resolving every issue and finding answers to every challenge of projects, customers and society.
Inspired by diversity of capability, the ability to grow flexibly, and the spirit of digging deep to break through in the AI era, “Root Further” was chosen as the official theme of the Sun* Annual Awards 2025.
Beyond its surface meaning, “Root Further” is the journey in which we keep reaching farther, rooting deeper, touching the hidden “geological” layers so we can survive, rise, and nurture the ever-burning passion for creating value that defines Sun* people.
rootFurther.quote:
“A tree with deep roots fears no storm”
(An English proverb)
rootFurther.closing: Before the storm, only trees with strong enough roots can stand firm. An organization of individuals confident in their diverse capabilities — ready to create, embrace challenges, and master change — is one that not only stands steady amid upheaval but also harnesses every advantage and conquers the challenges of the times. More than the name of a new chapter in the organization's journey, “Root Further” is an encouragement, urging each of us to dare to believe in ourselves, dare to dig deep, unlock every potential, break past limits, and become the most versatile, excellent version of ourselves.

kudos.label: Recognition movement
kudos.title: Sun* Kudos
kudos.body: A movement to recognize and thank colleagues — held for the first time for all Sunners. Launching in November 2025, it encourages Sun* people to share words of recognition and gratitude to colleagues on the system announced by the organizing committee. It will serve as reference material for the Heads Council when selecting award recipients.

topTalent.title: Top Talent
topTalent.description: The Top Talent award honors comprehensively outstanding individuals — people who consistently demonstrate solid professional expertise and outstanding work performance, always delivering value beyond expectations and earning high regard from clients and teammates alike. With a readiness to take on any task the organization assigns, they are a constant source of inspiration, driving motivation and a positive influence across the whole team.

topProject.title: Top Project
topProject.description: The Top Project award honors outstanding project teams that deliver business results beyond expectations, optimal operational efficiency, and dedicated teamwork. These are projects of high technical complexity that make the most of resources and cost, propose valuable ideas for clients, generate outstanding profit, and receive positive client feedback. Members strictly follow internal development standards throughout the project, setting a model of excellence and professionalism.

topProjectLeader.title: Top Project Leader
topProjectLeader.description: The Top Project Leader award honors outstanding project managers — people who combine solid management capability, a strong ability to inspire, and an “Aim High – Be Agile” mindset in every problem and context. Under their guidance, team members not only overcome challenges together and reach their goals, but also keep the fire of enthusiasm and the Wasshoi spirit alive, growing into more accomplished, happier versions of themselves.

bestManager.title: Best Manager
bestManager.description: The Best Manager award honors outstanding leaders — those who have guided their teams to results beyond expectations, with a standout impact on business performance and the organization's sustainable growth. Under their leadership, teams consistently conquer and master every goal through multitasking capability, effective collaboration, and a flexible, technology-driven mindset for the digital era. They inspire their teams to feel confident, energized, and ready to embrace — even lead — revolutionary change.

signatureCreator.title: Signature 2025 - Creator
signatureCreator.description: The Signature award honors the individual or team that embodies the distinctive spirit Sun* champions in a given period. In 2025, the Signature award honors the Creator — an individual/team with a proactive, sharp mindset who sees opportunity in every challenge and takes the lead in action. They are quick to spot problems, swiftly identify and deliver practical solutions, and bring clear value to projects, clients, or the organization. With a creative mindset and the “Creator” spirit distinctive to Sun*, they don't just respond positively to change — they actively drive improvement, helping shape a new standard for how Sun* people create value.

mvp.title: MVP (Most Valuable Person)
mvp.description: The MVP award honors the year's most outstanding individual — the standout figure who represents the entire Sun* team. They have shown exceptional capability, sustained dedication, and far-reaching influence, leaving a strong mark on Sun*'s journey over the past year. Beyond standing out through performance and results, they are also a spreading source of inspiration — through their thinking, actions, and positive influence on the team. The MVP embodies every quality of an outstanding Sun* person while carrying a great responsibility: to be a role model for Sun* people and spirit, helping lead the team to new heights.
